# Ebb and Flow Massage Studio

> Clinical massage therapy in Washington, DC specializing in lymphatic drainage, oncology massage, craniosacral therapy, and intra-oral and facial massage.

Updated: 2026-10-23

## About

Ebb and Flow is a clinical massage studio owned and operated by Natalie Gamble, a licensed massage therapist with advanced certifications in lymphatic drainage, oncology massage, and craniosacral therapy. Natalie sees clients in Washington, DC.

Natalie's credentials include: Licensed Massage Therapist (LMT), Certified Manual Lymphatic Drainage Therapist (CMLDT, Vodder technique, certified through Klose Training), Oncology Massage certification (through Tracy Walton & Associates), Medical Massage Practitioner (MMP, full certification through LMT Success Group, including intra-oral technique; she uses it specifically for Intra-Oral and Facial Massage), and Craniosacral Therapist (CST, certified through the Upledger Institute). She has also completed the MPS Scar Release Therapy course (Dolphin Neurostim).

## Services

### Lymphatic Drainage

- **Manual Lymphatic Drainage (MLD):** Gentle Vodder technique to support fluid movement, reduce swelling, and promote recovery. Used for fluid retention, post-travel swelling, seasonal wellness, and general lymphatic maintenance. Sessions can begin with optional non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation. $150 per session.
- **Pre/Post-Operative Lymphatic Massage:** Lymphatic support before and after surgery to reduce swelling, support comfort, scar healing, and recovery, including MPS scar release therapy for healed incisions. Requires provider approval. $150 per session.
- **Fertility and IVF Support Massage:** Gentle lymphatic work to support comfort during fertility treatments, including IVF. Helps with bloating, tenderness, and grounding. $150 per session.
- **Pregnancy and Postpartum Lymphatic Massage:** Lymphatic massage tailored for pregnancy-related swelling and postpartum recovery, including C-section scar tissue work and MPS scar release therapy with provider approval. $150 per session.
- **Lymphedema and Lipedema Management:** Ongoing massage support for people managing lymphedema or lipedema, focusing on heaviness, swelling, tenderness, and comfort. $150 per session.

### Oncology Massage

Safe, gentle massage adapted for people at any stage of cancer treatment, recovery, or survivorship. Natalie is certified in oncology massage through Tracy Walton & Associates. $130 per session.

### Craniosacral Therapy (CST)

Light-touch therapy working with the craniosacral system to support relaxation, nervous system regulation, and relief from tension patterns. Natalie is certified through the Upledger Institute. $150 per session.

### Intra-Oral and Facial Massage

A focused, specialized therapy working inside and outside the mouth to ease jaw tension, soften facial pressure, and help the head and neck feel lighter. Combines gentle external lymphatic work across the shoulders, neck, scalp, and face with intra-oral technique using sterile, latex-free gloves. For teeth clenching or grinding, TMJ discomfort, jaw fatigue, tension headaches, temple tightness, sinus pressure, and neck and shoulder tension. Not appropriate with active oral infections, cold sores, open mouth wounds, recent dental extractions or oral surgery, or acute facial nerve flare-ups; wait at least 7 days after Botox or facial fillers. Natalie trained in intra-oral technique as part of her Medical Massage Practitioner (MMP) certification through LMT Success Group. $150 per 60 minute session.

### Incorporated Techniques

These are not standalone services. They are incorporated into the session types above at no separate charge. Natalie completed the MPS Scar Release Therapy course and uses the Dolphin Neurostim (Microcurrent Point Stimulation) in her practice.

- **Scar Release Therapy:** Gentle Dolphin Neurostim microcurrent (MPS) applied along each side of a healed scar to soften and fade scar tissue, release adhesions, and restore circulation and lymph flow. Incorporated into Pre/Post-Operative and Pregnancy/Postpartum sessions for C-section, mastectomy, and other surgical scars once the incision is healed and cleared by a provider.
- **Vagus Nerve Stimulation (VNS):** Non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation via gentle microcurrent ear clips. Supports vagal tone and parasympathetic ("rest and digest") activity. Offered at the start of Manual Lymphatic Drainage and other bodywork sessions to deepen relaxation. Not appropriate for people with pacemakers or other implanted electrical devices, during pregnancy, or with seizure disorders.

## Client Reviews

As of October 2026, the Georgetown / Glover Park Google Business Profile has 32 reviews, all 5 stars: https://maps.google.com/?cid=913336461471092956

Selected reviews appear on each service page. What clients describe, by service (individual experiences vary):

- **Pre/Post-Op Lymphatic Massage:** recovery support after abdominal liposuction and scar revision, before and after a double mastectomy, and after double jaw surgery, including techniques to continue at home.
- **Lymphedema and Lipedema Management:** years of ongoing MLD for lipedema, and support for lymphedema-related swelling and discomfort.
- **Manual Lymphatic Drainage:** sessions tailored at each visit using the Vodder technique and tools like microcurrent, vibration, scraping, and taping; less bloating (including with SIBO); and careful assessment of which areas need the most work.
- **Oncology Massage:** customized clinical sessions with follow-up check-ins; a physician reviewer describes her work with post-surgical, oncology, and autoimmune patients.
- **Craniosacral Therapy:** a very gentle touch that leaves clients deeply relaxed and energized, with time after the session to explain what she noticed.
- **Pregnancy and Postpartum Lymphatic Massage:** relief from swelling, tingling, and numbness after an unexpected C-section.
